script.hook: Do NOT ignore boiler pressure dropping in sub-zero weather until you check this 60-second diagnostic.
script.body: Most households spend hundreds on emergency callouts for issues that can be fixed safely in under 15 minutes. Check your isolation valves, verify system pressure between 1.0 and 1.5 bar, and clear frozen external lines before calling any contractor.
